As an IT Project Manager/Scrum Master, you will: Lead multifaceted Information Technology (IT) software and infrastructure projects using waterfall, hybrid or agile delivery methods for the Railroad Retirement Board.

Work across functional and organizational lines and deal with the full range of issues and concerns associated with IT systems within the agency. Manage project resources, including overseeing contractors and mentoring IT and business teams.

Develop and implement plans, providing cost-benefit analysis, designing and conducting analytical studies, managing resources, and defining objectives and risks. Develop information systems testing strategies, identifying standards for infrastructure configuration, and developing information security plans and procedures.

Serve as an Agile scrum master for application development projects by developing and executing user/epic stories, roadmap, product backlog, sprints, Kanban tracking, retrospectives, etc.
Selective Placement Factor: This position includes a job-related knowledge, skill, and/or ability that is required for satisfactory performance for the position. Selective placement factors are a prerequisite to appointment and represents minimum requirements for a position. Application materials must demonstrate the selective placement factor.

Applicants who do not meet it are ineligible for further consideration. The Selective Placement Factor for this position is: Certification as a Project Management Professional (PMP) from the Project Management Institute.

(Project Management Professional (PMP)® Certification | PMI) In addition to meeting the selective placement factor above, to qualify for this position you must also meet the qualification requirements listed below. For Grade GS-14: Applicants must have IT-related experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below.

Applicants must demonstrate possession of these competencies within the body of the resume; no separate statements addressing them are required. Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. -AND- One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-13 grade level in the Federal service.

Specialized Experience is experience that has equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities/competencies to perform successfully the duties of the position and is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled.

Specialized experience is defined as demonstrated experience: Leading complex software and infrastructure IT projects using waterfall, hybrid, and Agile methodology. Developing IT project plans that incorporate risk controls, testing/training needs, acceptance criteria, change management, and IT governance.

Executing IT project work by monitoring technical progress, updating activities in tracking tools, resolving system-related impediments, and ensuring all required IT deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.

Planning and leading scrum ceremonies such as standups meetings, backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint review (demonstrations), release planning, and sprint retrospectives. Leading project teams and contractors by coaching, establishing goals, monitoring performance, and providing constructive feedback.

Managing stakeholder expectations by gathering input, resolving issues, and communicating project status to ensure transparency. Only experience obtained by the closing date of this announcement will be considered.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Documenting experience: IN DESCRIBING YOUR EXPERIENCE, PLEASE BE CLEAR AND SPECIFIC.

WE WILL NOT MAKE ASSUMPTIONS REGARDING YOUR EXPERIENCE. Qualifications are based on breadth/level of experience. In addition to describing duties performed, applicants must provide the exact dates of each period of employment (from MM/YY to MM/YY) and the number of hours worked per week if part time.

As qualification determinations cannot be made when resumes do not include the required information, failure to provide this information may result in disqualification. Applicants are encouraged to use the USAJOBS Resume Builder to develop their federal resume.

Do not copy and paste the duties or specialized experience from this announcement into your resume as that will not be considered a demonstration of your qualifications for this position.

Serves as the Aquatics Program Manager responsible for the daily operation and supervision of aquatic fitness, training and recreational programs, personnel, and classes at aquatic facilities. Manages multiple indoors and outdoors pools.
Provides overall supervision of the aquatic programs. Establishes and reviews the Aquatic programs. Establishes and reviews the Aquatic Risk Management plan for all aquatic facilities.
Coordinates with the MWR marketing department to publicize aquatic events. Establishes and executes processes to evaluate the effectiveness of the aquatic programs. Responsible for APF and NAF budget for assigned facilities and programs.
Develops and updates the Standard Operating Procedures for the aquatic facilities, programs and enforces policies. Interviews and selects such staff and provides them with required orientation, training and management to meet all activity needs.

Resumes must be two pages (or less). Resumes should clearly demonstrate the applicant's relevant experience, skills, knowledge and abilities as they pertain to this position. A qualified candidate must possess the following: Possesses demonstrated experience in planning, administering and executing aquatic programs.

This experience may have been gained managing indoor or outdoor aquatic programs and facilities. Required experience must have been equivalent to the next lower grade level. An undergraduate or graduate degree in related fields such as physical education or kinesiology may be substituted for six (6) months of the required work experience.

If using education in place of experience, transcripts must be uploaded at the time of application.

Possesses and maintains the following certifications: -American Red Cross Lifeguarding and First Aid -CPR for the Professional Rescuer/AED -Lifeguard Instructor (Red Cross) -Water Safety Instructor (Red Cross) -Aquatic Facilities Operator (AFO) or Certified Pool Operator (COP) certification In addition, for facilities that use Oxygen Administration & 02 bottles; the Oxygen Administration & 02 Administration certification (Red Cross or installation offered training) must be obtained within two weeks of reporting for duty.

In addition to the above qualifications, candidates who possess the following qualifications will be considered "Highly Preferred" or "Best Qualified": -Lifeguard Instructor Trainer (Red Cross) -Water Safety Instructor (Red Cross) -Equipment (Safe Operations and Basic Maintenance Repairs) -Nationally Recognized Basic Fitness Trainer Certification or Aquatic Exercise Association Instructor -Adapted Aquatics Instructor -SCUBA Diving Instructor (PADI, NAUI, YMCA or equivalent) Applicants who meet the Minimum qualifications, & Highly Preferred Criteria will be referred to management for consideration first.

All others may be referred if management does not make a selection from the Highly Preferred list.

About Phase2 Our remote first employees join and stay at Phase2 to be a force . In pursuit of digital experience that advances the human experience, you will do your best work, live fully, and succeed as a team.

Phase2 a digital agency passionate about customer experience, grounded in data & insights, and rooted in more than two decades of successful technology delivery. We guide industry-leading companies to what’s next in their digital slandscape. And it all begins with finding the right people who align with our values and passion for impact.

About the Role Phase2 is seeking a Senior Project Manager to own complex digital engagements and lead trusted, senior-level client relationships. Project managers often focus on the triple constraint of scope, time, and cost, but Phase2 is seeking a different breed of PM who can think beyond constraints.

Project Managers at Phase2 create a unique, engaging, and impactful client experience with long-term outcomes. They bring a future-focused perspective, anticipate client needs, and ensure decisions and direction align with what will drive meaningful progress and outcomes.

They bring clarity to ambiguity, guide clients through key decisions, and keep work moving forward, ensuring clients feel confident, supported, and satisfied.

This position reports to: VP, Project Management Compensation: Base annual salary of $120,000 - $155,000 What You’ll Do Own multi-workstream engagements end-to-end, ensuring delivery stays aligned with client goals, expected outcomes, and organizational standards.

Set direction by translating client objectives into structured plans, decision frameworks, and actionable priorities. Drive outcomes and client value with an emphasis on rapid time to value, using practical delivery discipline and AI-enabled approaches to accelerate insight, execution, and impact.

Lead the client relationship with confidence and clarity, ensuring expectations are understood, risks and mitigations are discussed early, and decisions continue moving forward. Direct cross-functional teams by establishing clear and outcome-aligned workflows, communication patterns, and accountability across all contributors.

Take ownership of engagement financials, including scope, forecasting, staffing, and margin performance, adjusting plans as conditions shift. Own and evolve the engagement roadmap and delivery approach ensuring work is sequenced to drive momentum, demonstrate value early, and unlock what’s next.

Embed AI tools into engagement workflows to strengthen planning, insight generation, communication, and decision support—setting expectations for how teams use AI to improve clarity, efficiency, and quality of work. Provide grounded recommendations that help clients evaluate tradeoffs, understand implications, and make informed decisions.

Identify risks early, lead mitigation efforts, and ensure issues are resolved with clarity and speed. Recognize and shape opportunities that arise naturally from delivery insight, client context, or emerging needs. Support the creation of proposals, estimates, and scopes that reflect realistic delivery plans and forward-looking client priorities.

What You’ll Need Significant experience owning complex digital engagements and leading senior client relationships. A strong instinct for bringing order to complexity—setting direction, aligning teams, and maintaining steady progress across multiple workstreams.

Demonstrated ability to solve problems creatively and constructively, balancing constraints across scope, budget, timelines, and team capacity without compromising outcomes. Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to lead client discussions, present recommendations, and guide decisions.

Deep understanding of digital platforms, product development lifecycles, and modern delivery practices. Demonstrated ability to embed AI in daily workflows and deliverables—using it to accelerate analysis, sharpen communication, synthesize information, and elevate the overall quality of engagement leadership.

Experience guiding teams in responsible, effective AI use, ensuring it enhances outcomes, improves speed and structure, and supports stronger decision-making. A track record of identifying meaningful opportunities rooted in client strategy, delivery insight, or future potential. Agency or consultancy experience preferred.

What Success Looks Like Clients feel led, supported, and confident in both the direction and decisions of the engagement. Teams operate with clarity, alignment, and consistent direction, even as priorities evolve. Engagements maintain predictable delivery, proactive risk management, and stable momentum.

Decisions are shaped with context, structure, and clear implications, enabling clients to move forward confidently. Clients feel energized and inspired by the clarity, momentum, and possibilities the partnership creates. New opportunities emerge naturally because the work is thoughtful, high-performing, and forward-looking.

Engagements meet expectations across delivery quality, relationship strength, and commercial performance. What You’ll Get The chance to make a real impact in the health and wellness space, helping millions of people per year. To work from wherever you thrive best. We’re a remote-first team built on trust, flexibility, and outcomes.

A competitive compensation package that considers various factors. A comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, and supplemental insurance. Our fun and interactive wellness program offers rewards for participation.

A 401(k) with a 3% employer contribution–no match required and 100% vested after just 90 days. You’ll start with 16 paid vacation days, 4 personal days, and 1 volunteer day each year. Vacation and personal time increase with your tenure, recognizing your continued contributions.

Up to 12 weeks of fully paid leave for birthing parents and up to 6 weeks of fully paid bonding leave, based on your tenure. This includes support for adoption and foster placement, along with the option to extend time off through additional unpaid leave.

Inclusive fertility, adoption, and surrogacy benefits through Kindbody, along with virtual health coaching and care navigation. A $500 stipend to personalize and equip your home workspace for success. What the Environment Looks Like Physical Demands Frequently remain in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time.

Occasional adjusting or moving of light objects up to 20 pounds in all directions. Continuous communication on live video chats, calls, and through emails and messaging platforms for the purpose of exchanging information. Continuous repetitive movements that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. Travel, sometimes frequent, is expected.

Mental Demands Comprehension - Must continuously be able to understand direction and adhere to established procedures. Must also be able to gather information from clients and employees and synthesize this information in a meaningful way. May also be responsible for making improvements or recommendations to existing procedures.

Organization - Must continuously be able to gather and classify information, store information learned from conversations and communications, and then be and be able to quickly recall, interpret, and explain information. Reasoning and Decision Making - Must continuously use logic to analyze and interpret information, and prioritize.

Communication - Must continuously express or exchange ideas and meaning with employees and clients. Resilience - Must continuously adapt well in the face of workplace stressors. You will assure planning estimates are established for timely receipt of funds.
You will resolve problems affecting the end cost, quality, schedule, and performance of contracts.
You will establish and maintain effective liaison relationships with Systems Commands, Type Commanders, Warfare Centers, and other customer representatives.
You will evaluate and analyze applicable policies and procedures and recommend changes to improve work processes utilizing manpower and material resources more effectively geared towards the overall project accomplishment.
You will coordinate, schedule, and administer assigned repair work to ensure that advanced planning functions are completed in time to permit orderly work list preparation, screening, specification preparations, and material ordering.
You will coordinate, edit, correlate, and perform quality audits of work specification packages to ensure authorized work is accomplished as agreed upon with customers.
You will develop new approaches, modify processes/techniques, and provide materials for guides/standards to be used by engineers, technicians, and others comprised of public and private resources to effect ship modernization, overhauls, and repair.
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-12 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: Planning and managing ship overhaul operations by evaluating production activities and estimating labor or material costs in order to develop and implement improvements for fleet modernization efforts.

Job Description & Responsibilities: The OneSix Sr. Project Manager is responsible for leading Client projects and global cross-functional OneSix teams to ensure solutions are delivered on time and on budget, and within the defined parameters of scope, timeline, and cost.

They are the day-to-day Point of Contact for Clients, and partner closely with the Technical Lead on the project to guide and support the larger delivery team.

The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, scheduling, and oversight of all project activities and deliverables, applying technical, theoretical, financial, and theoretical skills to satisfy project requirements, while building positive professional relationships with their Clients and delivery team.
Create and maintain delivery roadmap, based upon client’s priorities, backlog, and future initiatives.
Ensure Client’s business goals are understood, success is defined and expectations are set and met.
Establish clear project parameters supporting the success of all internal and client team members
Develop and maintain all project schedules that outline scoped activities, deliverables, tasks, sequences, work effort, and resource requirements.
Lead and oversee project execution, adhering to established processes and procedures and utilizing the appropriate tools on both macro roadmaps and individual projects.

Support the team in negotiating and managing project scope, ensuring all project team members are aligned and on task and obstacles are promptly addressed to maintain forward momentum.
Manage and mentor Project Managers, providing guidance, oversight, and professional development support to ensure consistent delivery excellence across engagements.
Forecast, track, and manage project budgets, burn, and expected revenue recognition, based upon fee structure. Track & manage budgetary & profit impacts based upon decisions made through project duration.
Ensure all project deliverables meet OneSix quality standards and are created based on brand standards and templates.
Plan and manage all project communications, both internal and external, ensuring clarity, efficient, clear, and actionable information.
Identify, review, prioritize, mitigate project risks and issues and escalate as needed to ensure project success.
Collaborate creatively and flexibly with clients and internal teams to resolve scope and budget challenges, delivering successful outcomes.
Understand and communicate client business needs and goals to the internal team, advocating for those needs throughout the project lifecycle.
Foster a positive and productive team environment by setting clear success criteria and supporting the growth and success of all team members.
Uphold high standards of professional integrity, managing team performance and dynamics with the support of OneSix Leadership.
Build strong client relationships to establish OneSix as a trusted partner, proactively identifying and flagging account expansion opportunities to leadership.
Participate in business development by proposing solutions for anticipated client needs, including overseeing scoping, estimation, and proposals for new opportunities.

Proven track record delivering software or technology implementation projects ranging from $500k to $1MM, leveraging agile or waterfall principles while adhering to budget, timeline, scope, and resource constraints.
Experience in a professional services environment (e.g., consulting firm, agency)
Skilled in managing multiple simultaneous engagements with delivery teams of 2-4+ FTEs across various fee structures (e.g., Time & Materials, Fixed Fee) and delivery models (e.g., Project, Retainer, Managed Services).
Demonstrated ability to effectively manage both external and internal clients, with a focus on senior-level stakeholder engagement.
Strong sense of urgency and a proactive approach to project management.
Exceptional multitasking abilities, with a talent for swiftly adapting to changing priorities.
Excellent communication skills—written, verbal, and listening—with meticulous attention to detail.
Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills, fostering collaborative environments.
Comprehensive understanding of project management principles, methods, and techniques
Knowledge of the software development lifecycle.
Understanding of financial concepts, including margin and revenue recognition across various fee structures and contract types
Experience with project estimation and writing SOWs, Change Orders, etc.
Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Project (or similar) and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint (or similar).

Written Test -- Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE)2 examination or any other written test required for professional registration by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, and Puerto Rico.

Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, and engineering sciences and that included the courses specified in the basic requirements under paragraph A.

Related curriculum -- Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor's degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance.

Depuis 30 ans, nous accompagnons des centaines d-entreprises dans les métiers techniques du bâtiment, de la construction et de l-industrie à travers la Suisse en leur proposant les meilleurs talents. On ne va toutefois pas te mentir, on est exigeant. Alors si tu es une personne motivée et hyper enthousiaste rejoins le clan pour le poste de Chef de projet contrôle d-accès et vidéosurveillance*
## **Ta mission :** ##
**Comprendre les besoins et concevoir des solutions adaptées**
Vous analysez les attentes et les contraintes des clients afin de proposer des solutions sur mesure en contrôle d-accès, vidéosurveillance et systèmes de sécurité électronique.
**Piloter les projets de bout en bout**
Vous assurez la gestion complète des projets, depuis l-étude technique jusqu-à la mise en service des installations. Vous planifiez les différentes étapes, coordonnez les ressources et veillez au bon déroulement des opérations.
**Coordonner les intervenants du projet**
Véritable chef d-orchestre, vous facilitez la communication entre les équipes techniques, les fournisseurs, les sous-traitants et les clients afin de garantir une exécution fluide et efficace.
**Garantir coûts, délais et qualité**
Vous suivez l-avancement des projets avec rigueur et veillez au respect des budgets, des délais et des standards de qualité tout au long du cycle de réalisation.
**Superviser les installations sur le terrain**
Présent sur le terrain, vous contrôlez la bonne exécution des travaux, vérifiez la conformité des installations et vous assurez du respect des normes et des spécifications techniques définies.
**Déployer des technologies de sécurité innovantes**
Vous participez à l-intégration de solutions avancées telles que les systèmes de vidéosurveillance IP (VMS), le contrôle d-accès, la biométrie et les technologies de sécurité de dernière génération.
**Être l-interlocuteur privilégié du client**
Vous accompagnez les clients tout au long du projet, en assurant un suivi régulier, des conseils adaptés et une communication claire, contribuant ainsi à leur satisfaction et à la réussite des projets
## **Maintenant si on parlait de toi ?** ##
**Une solide formation technique**
Vous êtes issu(e) d-une formation dans les domaines de l-électricité, de l-électronique, des télécommunications, de l-informatique ou d-un cursus technique équivalent. Cette base vous permet de maîtriser les enjeux liés aux systèmes de sûreté et de sécurité.
**Une expérience confirmée en gestion de projets**
Vous justifiez d-une expérience réussie dans le pilotage de projets de sécurité électronique, de contrôle d-accès, de vidéosurveillance ou d-infrastructures techniques. Vous maîtrisez l-ensemble du cycle de vie d-un projet, de la conception à la mise en service.
**Une bonne connaissance du marché suisse**
Une expérience en Suisse ou une excellente maîtrise des normes, réglementations et pratiques locales constitue un véritable atout pour évoluer efficacement dans la fonction.
**De solides compétences techniques**
Vous êtes à l-aise avec les systèmes de vidéosurveillance (CCTV), le contrôle d-accès, les réseaux IP, les solutions VMS ainsi que les technologies de sécurité électronique. Vous savez analyser les contraintes techniques et proposer des solutions adaptées aux besoins des clients.
**Un excellent sens de l-organisation**
Méthodique et autonome, vous savez gérer plusieurs projets simultanément, définir les priorités et anticiper les risques afin de garantir le respect des délais, des budgets et des objectifs fixés.
**Un relationnel qui fait la différence**
Grâce à votre aisance relationnelle et votre sens du service, vous développez des relations de confiance durables avec les clients, partenaires et équipes internes. Vous communiquez avec clarté et efficacité à tous les niveaux d-un projet.
**Une mobilité adaptée au poste**
Titulaire du permis de conduire, vous appréciez le terrain et êtes disposé(e) à vous déplacer sur différents sites afin d-assurer le suivi des projets et l-accompagnement des clients.
**Un profil orienté résultats**
Proactif(ve), engagé(e) et force de proposition, vous prenez des initiatives et apportez des solutions concrètes pour contribuer au succès des projets et à la satisfaction des clients

## Introduction de la société ##
OMEGA is a prestigious global brand with more than 170 years of commitment to quality, precision and innovation. Our watches are among the world-s finest, defined by industry-leading technology and timeless aesthetic appeal.
In our long history, we-ve set precision records, defined sports timing and remained at fine watchmaking-s cutting edge.
As an international brand, we are always interested in meeting future colleagues who are prepared to contribute their talents, ambitions and inspiration to our teams on practically every continent.
## Description du poste ##

As a vital member of the Social Media team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping OMEGA-s communication strategy and driving the evolution of the brand-s digital footprint. Your role demands a comprehensive grasp of Social Media and digital communication trends. You'll need to be naturally inquisitive, innovative, and proactive in seeking out new opportunities.

* Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to craft comprehensive 360 campaigns
* Establish and manage a detailed publication schedule aligning with the International Marketing plan
* Utilize our social management tool to schedule daily posts
* Enhance brand and product visibility across all digital platforms
* Coordinate cross-market projects effectively
* Spearhead live event initiatives
* Design and execute social media campaigns guided by specific KPIs
* Deliver comprehensive reports on social media campaigns and activities
* Analyze campaign performance to derive actionable insights and identify future opportunities
* Monitor and report on emerging digital trends
## Profil ##
* A background in digital communication within the luxury sector (minimum 3 years)
* Prior experience in a digital agency is an advantage
* A deep interest in the luxury and watch industry
* Experience working with Asian social media platforms (WeChat, Weibo, Douyin, LINE, etc.)
* Strategic approach, capable of interpreting data ecosystems into actionable insights
* A bachelor's degree in communication/marketing
* Excellent organizational skills, ability to meet deadlines, and adapt to dynamic environments
* Creativity and flexibility coupled with a strong team-oriented mindset
* Strong command of PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite is an advantage
## Langues ##
* Fluent in English. French would be an added value.

Wir suchen keine perfekten Profile. Wichtig sind uns Interesse an Bildung, Chancengleichheit und an der Mission von BRASCRI sowie die Bereitschaft, sich strategisch einzubringen. Interessant könnte die Arbeit in unserem Vorstand besonders für Persönlichkeiten sein, die:

s.h: A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US
s.t:
We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.
About Foundant
At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.
We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung
Ihre Aufgaben
HR\-Projektmanagement und Konzeptentwicklung

Sie hinterfragen bestehende Prozesse, erkennen Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickeln daraus praxistaugliche Lösungen.
Sie erarbeiten Konzepte, Entscheidungsgrundlagen und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für die Geschäftsleitung.
Sie bereiten komplexe Themen verständlich auf und vertreten Ihre Projekte gegenüber der Geschäftsleitung, Führungskräften und weiteren Anspruchsgruppen.
Sie gestalten Workshops, führen unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammen und begleiten Veränderungs\- und Optimierungsprozesse.
Sie wirken bei der Entwicklung und Überarbeitung von Reglementen, Weisungen und Richtlinien mit und sorgen für deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung.
Sie entwickeln HR\-Instrumente und Standards weiter und optimieren Prozesse entlang des gesamten HR\-Lifecycles.
Sie treiben die Digitalisierung voran und leisten einen aktiven Beitrag zur weiteren Professionalisierung des HR\-Bereichs.
HR\-Support

Sie arbeiten bei verschiedenen HR\-Prozessen mit und unterstützen bei der Umsetzung laufender HR\-Themen und Projekte.
Sie erstellen Auswertungen, Statistiken, Präsentationen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen und bereiten relevante Informationen adressatengerecht auf.
Sie unterstützen Führungskräfte und Mitarbeitende bei HR\-relevanten Fragestellungen und stellen eine professionelle und lösungsorientierte Bearbeitung sicher.
Sie wirken bei der Pflege, Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von HR\-Systemen und digitalen HR\-Prozessen mit.
Sie erkennen Verbesserungspotenziale im operativen HR\-Alltag und bringen eigene Ideen zur Vereinfachung und Professionalisierung der Abläufe ein.
Ihr Profil
Sie verfügen über mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Human Resources und haben bereits HR\-Projekte oder bereichsübergreifende Vorhaben erfolgreich umgesetzt.
Es bereitet Ihnen Freude, komplexe Fragestellungen zu analysieren, Konzepte zu entwickeln und diese in praxistaugliche Lösungen zu übersetzen.
Sie bewegen sich sicher zwischen operativem Tagesgeschäft und strategischen Themen und behalten auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick.
Sie kommunizieren adressatengerecht und treten gegenüber Führungskräften sowie der Geschäftsleitung überzeugend auf.
Veränderungen verstehen Sie als Chance und bringen neue Ideen mit der nötigen Umsetzungsstärke voran.
Sie arbeiten strukturiert, selbstständig und übernehmen gerne Verantwortung.
Eine Weiterbildung im Bereich Human Resources, Betriebswirtschaft oder Projektmanagement rundet Ihr Profil ab
Wir bieten
Wir bieten attraktive und zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen sowie ein vielseitiges Tätigkeitsumfeld bei einem fortschrittlichen Arbeitgeber. In unmittelbarer Nähe haben Sie Anschluss an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel. Zudem befinden sich auf dem Areal Parkmöglichkeiten sowie eigene Kindertagesstätten in Bassersdorf und Embrach.
Über uns
Das KZU Kompetenzzentrum Pflege und Gesundheit ist fest im Unterland verwurzelt – mit vier Standorten in Embrach, Bassersdorf, Nürensdorf und Winkel und knapp 700 Mitarbeitenden sowie 86 Lernenden und Studierenden in 18 verschiedenen Berufen. Bei uns finden Sie ein breites Spektrum an Tätigkeitsfeldern und Dienstleistungen unter einem Dach: Langzeit\- sowie Akut\- und Übergangspflege, Spitex, Tageszentrum, Ergo\- und Physiotherapie, Gastronomie und betriebseigene Kitas und viele mehr.
Was uns verbindet? Der Mensch, der im Zentrum steht – ob als Bewohnende, Kunden, Mitarbeitende oder Angehörige. Im Alltag spürbar in der Zusammenarbeit über Berufs\- und Standortgrenzen hinweg, in echtem gegenseitigem Respekt und in einem Umfeld, das innovativ denkt und trotzdem bodenständig bleibt.

Zudem bietet Implenia in weiteren Märkten Tunnelbau- und damit verbundene Infrastrukturprojekte.

Das Unternehmen fasst das Know-how aus hochqualifizierten Beratungs-, Entwicklungs-, Planungs- und Ausführungseinheiten unter einem Dach zu einem integrierten, multinational führenden Bau- und Immobiliendienstleister zusammen.

Mit Hauptsitz in Opfikon bei Zürich beschäftigt Implenia europaweit über 8 000 Mitarbeitende (FTE) und erzielte im Jahr 2025 einen Umsatz von CHF 3,5 Mrd. Weitere Informationen unter implenia.com

This position serves as the Deputy Psychologist Program Manager for the Specialty Mental Health Clinic BHIP Teams (MHC). The MHC is a multidisciplinary outpatient program within the MH Service that provides state-of-the-art mental health services for veterans based on the psychiatric rehabilitation recovery model.

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to: The incumbent serves the Deputy Program Manager for a BHIP location.

Deputy program managers have broad program management responsibilities for a specific program that is designed to deliver specialized, complex, highly professional services that are important program components of the facility and that significantly impact the health care provided to Veterans.

Decisions made by the Deputy program Manager affect staff and other resources associated with the programs managed and are made while exercising wide latitude and independent judgment. The type of program managed and scope of responsibility are critical aspects of the assignment at this level.

Responsibilities include operation and management of key clinical, training, research, and administrative activities for the BHIP location, to include full responsibility for managing the day to day activities of the BHIP program. Responsibility includes some supervision of staff.

Deputy Program Managers are responsible for strategic planning to ensure the provision of high-quality services to meet the needs of the Veterans being served and planning, and developing and implementing short-and long-term goals and objectives consistent with the program's strategic plan.

Basic Requirements United States Citizenship: Non-citizens may only be appointed when it is not possible to recruit qualified citizens in accordance with VA Policy.

Education Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully complete a re-specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re-specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and, the specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature.

Internship Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern; OR VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96-151 (pre-1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement; OR Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification.) OR Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program.

Licensure: Hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

English Language Proficiency: Psychologists must be proficient in spoken and written English in accordance with VA Handbook 5005, Part II, Chapter 3, section A, paragraph 3j.

Son développement repose sur une approche alliant excellence technique, proximité avec ses partenaires et capacité à mener des projets exigeants dans le respect des plus hauts standards de qualité.

Vous prenez la responsabilité complète de projets d'infrastructures, depuis les premières phases d'études jusqu'à la mise en service des ouvrages.
En tant que véritable chef d'orchestre, vous assurez la coordination des équipes internes, des mandataires spécialisés, des entreprises et des maîtres d'ouvrage. Vous êtes garant·e de la bonne conduite des mandats tant sur les aspects techniques que financiers et organisationnels.
Votre fonction nécessite une vision globale des projets ainsi qu'une forte capacité à anticiper les enjeux liés à la planification, aux coûts, aux risques et aux contraintes d'exécution. Vous veillez à assurer un équilibre constant entre les exigences techniques, les attentes des clients et les impératifs opérationnels.
Vous intervenez également comme interlocuteur privilégié des différents partenaires du projet et contribuez activement à la qualité des relations développées avec les collectivités publiques, les autorités et les acteurs de la construction.
**Vos responsabilités**
Vous pilotez les études et les différentes phases de conception des projets en veillant à leur cohérence technique et économique.
Vous assurez la planification générale des mandats et coordonnez l'ensemble des intervenants afin de garantir le respect des délais, des budgets et des objectifs définis.
Vous supervisez les procédures d'appels d'offres et accompagnez les maîtres d'ouvrage dans les processus liés aux marchés publics.
Vous assurez la direction des travaux et le suivi des chantiers, avec une présence régulière sur le terrain afin de garantir la qualité des réalisations et la bonne gestion des interfaces.
Vous encadrez et accompagnez les équipes de projet, favorisez la circulation de l'information et contribuez à la montée en compétence des collaborateurs.
Enfin, vous participez activement aux réflexions techniques et au développement de solutions innovantes répondant aux enjeux actuels de mobilité, de durabilité et d'aménagement du territoire.
**Votre profil**
Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'Ingénieur EPF, HES ou équivalent reconnu en Suisse, ou d'une formation de Technicien ES complétée par une solide expérience professionnelle.
Vous justifiez d'au moins cinq années d'expérience au sein d'un bureau d'ingénieurs civils en Suisse, avec une exposition significative à la gestion de projets et à la direction de travaux dans le domaine des infrastructures routières et/ou ferroviaires.
Vous maîtrisez les normes VSS et SIA ainsi que les procédures liées aux marchés publics. Une bonne connaissance de l'environnement réglementaire suisse constitue un prérequis pour cette fonction.
Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils de gestion de projet et maîtrisez notamment le logiciel Messerli.
Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu·e pour votre sens de l'organisation, votre rigueur, votre capacité à prendre des décisions et à fédérer les différents intervenants autour d'objectifs communs.
